principle: T5 diagnosis represents end-of-secondary curriculum mastery and readiness evidence. Curriculum mastery, SPM assessment performance, AI confidence and teacher judgement remain separate.

evidence_policy.written: marked physical exercises, school tests, essays, comprehension, grammar, editing and literary responses
evidence_policy.oral: audio/video/teacher observation required for speaking/listening performance
evidence_policy.ocr_uncertain: never count as confirmed learner error
evidence_policy.teacher_mark: priority for correctness where clearly visible; root cause still requires analysis

confidence_rules.high: cross-task, cross-date, multi-source evidence with clear attribution

backtracking_rule: For persistent T5 weakness, inspect T4 then earlier prerequisite nodes and repair the earliest demonstrated break rather than reteaching an entire lower form.
assessment_separation: SPM-style marks and paper-section performance are assessment evidence. They do not replace curriculum micro-skill mastery.
closure_rule: A weakness closes only after later independent success, preferably across more than one task type.
